Pauline (French: Pauline Julien: femme pays) is a Canadian biographical drama film, directed by Anaïs Barbeau-Lavalette and released in 2026. The film is a portrait of Pauline Julien, a singer and Quebec sovereignty activist who was a significant figure in the musical and political history of Quebec. 
The film stars Suzanne Clément as Julien and Patrice Dubois as her husband, poet Gérald Godin, as well as Violette Chauveau, Véronique Côté, Mario Dallaire, Éléonore Delvaux-Beaudoin, Alexa-Jeanne
